Asian Games Archery and Squash Medals Won

Ganesh Mani Ratnam Thirumuru won a bronze medal in the men's individual compound archery at the Asian Games 2026, defeating Vietnam's Cong Duc Dang 149-144 in the bronze medal playoff. He was also part of the gold-winning men's team. In squash, the Indian men's and women's teams secured bronze medals after losing their semifinal matches.
